2608.19974.title: ReguSim: Evaluating LLM Agent Rule Grounding in Financial Compliance
2608.19974.paper_summary: LLM agents in financial markets may cite rules yet still submit orders that violate executable constraints or misread surveillance evidence. We introduce ReguSim, a controlled financial-compliance environment, and ReguBench, a target-marked monitoring benchmark, to separate four artifacts: stated reasoning, attempted action, execution enforcement, and monitor evidence. In trader runs with DeepSeek V4 Pro and Gemini 3.5 Flash, visible rules reduce but do not eliminate rejected actions, and incentive or persona framing shifts behavior. A bridge study shows that trader rationales can mislead an independent monitor unless enforcement evidence is shown. In monitoring, simple structured baselines either match or exceed prompt-only LLMs. The results frame financial compliance evaluation as an audit of rule-grounded actions and evidence use, rather than a single compliance score.
2608.19974.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理在金融市場中可能會引用規則，但仍然提交違反可執行約束或錯誤解讀監控證據的訂單。我們介紹了 ReguSim，一個受控的金融合規環境，以及 ReguBench，一個目標標記的監控基準，以區分四個工件：陳述的推理、嘗試的行動、執行強制和監控證據。在使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的交易者運行中，明顯的規則減少了但並未消除被拒絕的行動，而激勵或角色框架則改變了行為。一項橋接研究顯示，交易者的理由可能會誤導獨立監控者，除非顯示執行證據。在監控中，簡單的結構基準要麼匹配要麼超過僅提示的 LLM。這些結果將金融合規評估框定為對基於規則的行動和證據使用的審計，而不是單一的合規分數。
